blocks.text:
To: Barbara Hall
Cc: David Sherman, Jeffrey Ochoa
Thank you for clarifying the status codes so quickly. With that in hand, the member file reconciles to your summary line for line, and we can treat the active and deferred groups as settled.

One more thing would help us before we start tabulating. A handful of records show a termination date but no benefit commencement, and we want to be sure we count them the way your office intends rather than guessing. Could you tell us whether those members are still owed a deferred benefit or whether they took their money out? David Sherman flagged them yesterday, and Jeffrey Ochoa would rather build the assumption around the real answer than around ours.
If you can point us to whoever keeps the payment records at Estes Group, we will take the detail up with them directly and keep the {{fact:f:E-2019-001.client}} study moving.
